meta.title: 这样拍，更和谐～
meta.title_en: Shoot It This Way — More Harmony

scenes.context: 红豆这么多，你却总是看那颗黄豆——能看最突出的事物就是天生的审美。
sentences: 我总觉得我审美太差了。
I always feel my sense of aesthetics is terrible.
There are so many red beans.
可你看的却总是这颗黄豆。
But your eyes always land on that one yellow bean.
paraphrase: 把「审美」换个更地道的说法
I always think my eye for beauty is terrible.
「视线落在」另一种表达
Your gaze always goes to that single yellow bean.
scenes.speak: I always feel my sense of aesthetics is terrible. Actually, you're born with it. There are so many red beans. But your eyes always land on that one yellow bean.

scenes.context: 只有红豆没重点，黄豆太多又杂乱——一颗黄豆既有重点又舒服。
sentences: 一个画面如果只有红豆，就没有重点。
A frame with only red beans has no focal point.
Viewers don't know where to look.
黄豆太多，又变得很杂乱。
Too many yellow beans make it cluttered.
只有一颗黄豆，既有重点又舒服。
With just one, it's focused and comfortable.
paraphrase: 把「没有重点」换个说法
Without a focal point, the eye wanders.
「又杂乱」另一种表达
Too many highlights and the frame feels messy.
scenes.speak: A frame with only red beans has no focal point. Viewers don't know where to look. Too many yellow beans make it cluttered. With just one, it's focused and comfortable.

scenes.title_cn: 眼睛会找黄豆，相机不会
scenes.title_en: Your Eyes Find It; Your Camera Won't
scenes.context: 好风景拍出来丑，因为眼睛会找重点而相机不会——要帮相机找黄豆。
sentences: 明明很美的风景，拍出来就很丑。
A beautiful scene turns out ugly when you shoot it.
你的眼睛会找黄豆，但相机不会。
Your eyes find the focal point, but the camera doesn't.
它只是一台机器，它不懂美。
It's just a machine; it doesn't understand beauty.
Help the camera find that focal point.
paraphrase: 把「结果拍得很丑」换个说法
A stunning view can end up looking terrible in a photo.
「帮相机找到重点」另一种表达
Guide the camera to what matters most.
scenes.speak: A beautiful scene turns out ugly when you shoot it. Your eyes find the focal point, but the camera doesn't. It's just a machine; it doesn't understand beauty. Help the camera find that focal point.

scenes.context: 穿搭、化妆、海报设计——生活里的每一处都需要一个重点。
sentences: There are focal points everywhere in life.
一个造型需要一个亮点。
paraphrase: 把「处处有重点」换个说法
Every corner of life has a visual anchor.
「亮点」另一种表达
An outfit works best with one standout piece.
scenes.speak: There are focal points everywhere in life. Take outfits, for example. Every look needs a highlight.

scenes.context: 先能拍好一颗黄豆，才可能拍好更多颗——创造的自由建立在基本功上。
sentences: 你可能想拍更宏大的世界。
You may want to shoot something bigger and grander.
First, learn to shoot one focal point well.
你才有可能拍好更多颗。
Only then can you shoot many of them well.
创造的自由建立在扎实的基本功上。
Creative freedom is built on solid fundamentals.
paraphrase: 把「更宏大的」换个说法
You might want to capture something more epic.
「建立在…基础上」另一种表达
Real creative freedom rests on a strong foundation.
scenes.speak: You may want to shoot something bigger and grander. First, learn to shoot one focal point well. Only then can you shoot many of them well. Creative freedom is built on solid fundamentals.

practice: 你的眼睛会找黄豆，但相机不会。
Your eyes find the focal point, but the camera doesn't.
一个画面如果只有红豆，就没有重点。
A frame with only red beans has no focal point.
Help the camera find that focal point.
创造的自由建立在扎实的基本功上。
Creative freedom is built on solid fundamentals.
pitfalls: I think my aesthetic is bad.
I think my sense of aesthetics is terrible.
aesthetic 常作形容词，名词要说 sense of aesthetics
The picture only has red beans have no focus.
A frame with only red beans has no focal point.
一个句子只能有一个谓语动词
Help the camera find that focal point.
the camera 需加冠词；focal point 是固定说法
Creative freedom is built on solid fundamentals.
be built on 是被动态，不能省略 be
shifts: 天生会看重点就是审美
先想清楚画面里的一颗黄豆
先拍好一颗黄豆再进阶
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：视频原文「公职」识别为「功底」，正文统一。
